name: Hiatari Ryoukou!
source: The game does not have you playing the protagonist from the anime, but an original male character staying at the same boarding house and interacting with those characters as friends. Mild nudity is possible by spying on Kasumi in the changing room.
translation: 本作并不让玩家扮演动画中的主人公，而是扮演一名原创男性角色。他住进与原作角色相同的寄宿公寓，以朋友身份和他们相处。玩家若在更衣室偷窥岸本霞，可能看到轻微裸露画面。
